title: Thank you. These two words change lives.
html:
Happy Holidays!

You get 86,400 seconds a day, that looks like a big number but those seconds tick by at a pace we seem to set ourselves.

In a hurry = never enough time.

In the flow of what your doing = time almost slows down.

It can be so easy then to think to yourself, it’s ok I will say thank you, I appreciate you or call someone later and then the day flies by and the moment is gone.

I believe you should say or do things straight away. Call or text that person as soon as they pop into your mind.

For example, thank you. These two words change lives. Yes, they are that powerful. Say them more often and you will be amazed at the results.

You know if you wake up every day and your family are alive and well and add to that you're in NZ there is a lot to be thankful for. When I do I'm starting my day at Happiness Level 10!

Have a wonderful Christmas and remember to make good use of your 86,400 seconds. They don't go on forever...

Best regards,
Glenn Edley

Quote for the week

God gave you a gift of 86,400 seconds today. Have you used one to say “Thank you?”

- William A. Ward
